summary: A dense, fully reachable control deck on top of an instrument that makes no sound and cannot be played with a mouse. The deck is the strong half: six sections at exactly the specified fractions (0.140/0.200/0.085/0.125/0.250/0.200), 0.905 viewport width, exactly two OLEDs in Program and Synth, 132 named controls, 120/120 reachable on the 5x5 elementFromPoint grid, and honest decorative behaviour. Two failures dominate. First, no audio path exists: AudioContext/Audio/OfflineAudioContext are constructed zero times, the served bundle holds no Web Audio symbol, and PianoEngine.render() is called only from tests - yet IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json claims the browser drains the engine into the speakers and the status strip permanently reads 'ready'. Second, a unit bug lays 72 of 73 keys beyond the keybed (to x=56000 in a 1370px bed) under a full-width overlay, so 0/73 keys are pointer-reachable; only mapped computer keys and MIDI reach the lifecycle, silently. The sealed visual audit asserts a depressing 73-key keybed its own screenshot refutes. Gates reproduce cleanly (58 tests, typecheck, lint, build) but exercise the model in jsdom, never the built page.

criteria.label: Piano voice
evidence: The published build never creates any audio output object. With AudioContext, webkitAudioContext, OfflineAudioContext and Audio all proxied by an addInitScript before page load, the constructor counter stayed at 0 through page load, a pointer press on the keybed, computer-keyboard notes (z, x, c), MIDI note-on via an injected requestMIDIAccess, and sustain toggling (scratch/probe-p1-interact.json, every 'audio' field {ctx:0}). document.querySelectorAll('audio,video').length is 0 and no window key matches /audio/i.

Static confirmation on the exact served bundle: grep for AudioContext|webkitAudioContext|createScriptProcessor|audioWorklet|createBufferSource|OscillatorNode|GainNode|new Audio over build/assets/index-peaxqnv0.js returns zero hits; grep -o 'Audio[A-Za-z]*' returns nothing at all.

The synthesiser exists but is orphaned: artifact/src/audio/engine.ts PianoEngine.render() is the only sound-producing routine, and the only callers of .render( in the whole artifact are artifact/tests/audio.test.ts. App.tsx constructs PianoEngine and NoteLifecycle but nothing ever pulls PCM out of it, so pressing a key changes aria-pressed and nothing else.

A warm-up note was played first (pointer press on the keybed, then keyboard 'z' held 250ms) before every measurement, per the fallback-voice trap; the audio counters were identical before and after, so this is not a first-note artefact.

criteria.label: Declared source honesty
evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json audio.strategy states 'The browser drains the engine into the speakers via the Web Audio path'. Exercising the build disproves it: 0 AudioContext constructions and no Web Audio symbol anywhere in build/assets/index-peaxqnv0.js. The declaration describes a signal path that does not exist in the shipped artifact.

The running UI repeats the claim: the status strip reads 'Basic piano ready (synthesized voice)' with a green ready dot from load onward (measured on the served build at 1440x900), while nothing is audible on any input path. src/piano/status.ts supports loading/error/fallback states, but App.tsx unconditionally calls status.setReady, so the honest states are never reachable.

What is declared about the *character* of the source is accurate as far as it goes - one generated partial-stack voice, no recordings, no network (sampleSources: [], one generatedSources entry), and the build issues only three requests (index.html, the JS chunk, the CSS chunk; scratch/probe-p1-base.json). The failure is the claim of audible output, not a sample mislabelled as a recording.

IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json notes[2] also asserts 'Every panel control from the visual spec is present, moves/presses accessibly'; the nine organ drawbars do not move (measured below), so a second declared claim is contradicted by the build.

criteria.label: Input coverage
evidence: Pointer input to the keybed is entirely dead. Using the 5x5 elementFromPoint grid at 1440x900 with the page unscrolled, 0 of 73 key elements are reachable. Real trusted mouse presses at three points across the keybed (x-fractions 0.1, 0.5, 0.9 at 80% of keybed height) each produced an empty '.key[aria-pressed=true]' set. Every probe point resolves to DIV.keys-black, an absolutely positioned full-keybed overlay at z-index 2 that swallows all pointer events.

The underlying cause is a unit bug in artifact/src/hardware/keys.ts: key.x is a white-key index (0..42) and key.width is 1, and Keybed.tsx renders style={{left: `${key.x*100}%`, width: `${key.width*100}%`}}. Measured consequence on the served build: key rects run from x=69.6 to x=56000.5 inside a keybed spanning x 69.6-1370.4; each white key is 1300.7px wide. Only 1 of 73 keys falls inside the keybed bounds.

Computer keyboard works: with focus cleared, holding 'z' set key MIDI 60 to aria-pressed=true, adding 'x' gave the concurrent set [60, 62], and releasing both cleared it (scratch/probe-p1-interact.json kbDown/kbTwoNotes/kbUp). The map covers 24 notes (MIDI 60-83) of the 73-note E1-E7 bed.

Web MIDI works: with an injected navigator.requestMIDIAccess, the app bound onmidimessage on the fake input, the status strip read 'MIDI connected', 0x90/67/100 pressed key 67, 0x80/67/0 released it, and CC64 127/0 drove the sustain button's aria-pressed true/false. Without an injected access the strip degrades honestly to 'MIDI unavailable'.
No input path is audible - see pianoVoice - so even the two working paths reach only presentation state, never a note.

criteria.label: Voice lifecycle
evidence: The state machine is complete and correct in source: artifact/src/audio/engine.ts implements MAX_VOICES=32 with deterministic oldest-onset stealing (voices sorted oldest-first, splice of the lowest onset), a per-voice release captured at beginRelease with RELEASE_S=0.5 exponential decay, and setSustain(false) releasing every sustained voice; artifact/src/piano/lifecycle.ts refcounts presses per note so overlapping sources share one voice and adds forceRelease/dispose. 58 unit tests over this model pass on a clean pnpm install.

None of it is audible. The engine's render() is never called outside artifact/tests/audio.test.ts and no AudioContext is ever constructed, so velocity->gain (v^1.12*0.95), brightness tracking, sustain tails and voice stealing have no rendered consequence in the build. The rubric's audible behaviours are provable only against a synthesiser the page never drains.

Cleanup is observable and correct: holding 'c' set key 64 pressed, then dispatching a window blur cleared every pressed key (scratch/probe-p1-interact.json beforeBlur=[64], afterBlur=[]). Sustain latches from Space, from the UI 'Sustain pedal' button and from MIDI CC64, and clears on release in all three.

Velocity is effectively fixed for the two human input paths: Keybed.tsx sends 0.85 for every pointer press and ComputerKeyboard sends 0.8 for every key, so only MIDI carries dynamics (value/127). There is no velocity gesture on the keybed at all.

criteria.label: Control feel & decorative boundary
evidence: Coverage and reachability of the deck are genuinely good: 120 of 120 interactive deck controls pass the 5x5 elementFromPoint reachability grid at 1440x900 (0 unreachable), and 132 labelled deck elements carry an aria-label with 63 sliders all exposing aria-valuenow.

Most control classes move and report honestly under a real pointer/keyboard: 'Master level' 0.8 -> 0.4 after 8 ArrowDown (one event per animation frame) and back to 0.6 after 4 ArrowUp, with the knob pointer transform rotating accordingly; a real mouse press toggles 'Vibrato on/off' aria-checked false->true and Enter toggles it back; 'Program button 1' (momentary) is aria-pressed true only while the button is held; the pitch stick reaches 0.66 'Up' on drag and springs back to 0.5 'Center' on release; the 'Organ level' fader cap and LED ladder track a drag.

The nine organ drawbars - a required Organ landmark - are effectively inert. A real 300px upward drag on '16 foot drawbar' left aria-valuenow at 0, aria-valuetext '0', and the handle at bottom 0px (travel fraction 0.000 of a 42.3px track). Five PageUp presses (one per animation frame) only reached aria-valuenow 1 of a declared max 8, handle bottom 5.28px. Cause: DrawbarControl passes pos=n/8 into useDragValue but writes the raw 0..1 result back to the store, so each gesture re-divides and the value saturates near 0.09.

Value reporting contradicts the rendering on segmented faders: at rest 'Organ level' reports aria-valuenow 0.7 with aria-valuetext '1/11' while the cap sits at 70% and 8 of 12 ladder segments are lit; 'Piano layer A level' reports '1/11' at 0.8 with 9 segments lit. Home/End are treated as deltas rather than absolutes in useDragValue (Home = +1, End = +0), so on 'Filter cutoff' End was a no-op (0.8 -> 0.8) and Home jumped to 1.0.

The decorative boundary itself is respected: driving the program dial through five ArrowUp steps moved its aria-valuetext to '5' while both OLEDs stayed at their static 'A:001 Grand' / 'SYNTH' text, and no panel control starts a note or claims audio. No console errors or page errors were emitted during the entire interaction pass.

criteria.label: Required Phase 1 controls present
evidence: All six sections render in order at exactly the documented deck fractions - measured 0.1400 / 0.2000 / 0.0850 / 0.1250 / 0.2500 / 0.2000 against the spec's 0.14 / 0.20 / 0.085 / 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.20 - and the instrument occupies 0.905 of the 1440px viewport (spec range 0.88-0.97), with no scroll in either axis.

Labelled control counts per section on the served build: performance 4, organ 30 (9 drawbars, 9 LED ladders, 4 model switches, percussion on + decay + level, rotary speed/drive, vibrato + chorus, level fader), piano 20 (six type selectors, model encoder, A/B level faders and focus, KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res, section on, SUSTPED, PSTICK), program 20 (OLED, dial, eight program buttons, page up/down, Live Mode, two Layer Scenes, Store, Split, three morph assigns), synth 29 (OLED, three layer faders + focus, osc, filter, envelopes, LFO, glide, vibrato, arp), effects 29 (two mod groups, amp/EQ, delay, compressor, reverb, rotary, five layer-focus buttons).
Exactly two primary OLEDs, in Program and Synth (document.querySelectorAll('.oled').length === 2, one in each of those sections and none elsewhere), matching the phase-1 hard gate.

Placement deviation: the Rotary Speaker block is absent from the performance band. The visual spec's performance sectionLandmarks require 'rotary speaker controls' on the exposed red chassis there (with the photo cited at x 2200-2500 of 11600), but the performance section renders only Pitch stick, Modulation wheel, Master level and branding; the rotary controls sit in Organ (organ.rotary-speed, organ.rotary-drive) and again in Effects (fx.rotary-speed, fx.rotary-on).

Legibility, not inventory, is the other weak point: at 1440x900 the 110px-wide piano section stacks 20 legends into overlapping 4-5px type (see scratch/probe-p1-desktop.png), though every control keeps a correct aria-label - 0 of 132 labelled deck elements are missing a name.

criteria.label: Required piano feature IDs
evidence: tests/feature-matrix.json maps all 11 required phase-1 IDs to non-empty test files and the suite reproduces on a clean install (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile then vitest: 9 files, 58 tests passing; typecheck, lint and build also pass, and the rebuilt bundle is byte-identical in name to the published assets/index-peaxqnv0.js). But the tests exercise the model in jsdom, not the build.

piano.basic-note-lifecycle and piano.basic-sustain-polyphony are unexercisable in the running build: no audio object is ever constructed, so note on/off, release tails, sustain and 32-voice stealing have no rendered signal. The only assertions about audio run PianoEngine.render() directly (tests/audio.test.ts), a path the app never invokes.

piano.basic-inputs is only two-thirds live in the build: keyboard and MIDI (with an injected access) drive the shared lifecycle, but pointer and touch are dead - 0 of 73 keys are reachable by the 5x5 elementFromPoint grid and real mouse presses across the keybed produce no press state. tests/interaction.test.tsx proves multi-touch with fireEvent.pointerDown on the element directly, which bypasses hit-testing and so cannot catch this.

piano.basic-status-cleanup is half-honest: the status model supports loading/error/fallback and blur/dispose cleanup verifiably clears held notes, but App.tsx calls status.setReady unconditionally, so the build permanently claims 'Basic piano ready (synthesized voice)' for a voice that cannot be heard.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
evidence: The two largest gaps in the artifact are undeclared and are instead asserted as working. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json audio.strategy claims 'The browser drains the engine into the speakers via the Web Audio path' (no audio object is ever constructed in the served build), and notes[2] claims 'Every panel control from the visual spec is present, moves/presses accessibly' (the nine organ drawbars do not move: 0.000 travel fraction under a 300px real drag).

Nothing at all is declared unimplemented beyond phase scope, so there are no over-declared gaps - the failure is entirely one of undeclared missing behaviour. The broken keybed (72 of 73 keys laid out beyond the keybed's right edge, up to x=56000 in a 1370px-wide bed) appears nowhere in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md or the visual audit.

The sealed evidence affirmatively contradicts itself: evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md asserts '73 keys, range E1-E7, 43 white / 30 black, black-key height 61% of white. Keys depress on press', while its own evidence/stage1-desktop.png shows the keybed as a single featureless white slab with a lone 'E1' legend - the same rendering I reproduced from build/ at 1440x900. IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md likewise ticks all five phase-1 hard gates.

The one deviation that is declared - the 600px instrument height against the photo's 3.095 aspect - is real and honestly described (measured aspect 2.171), which shows the declaration mechanism works when used; it simply was not used for the failures that matter.

issues.title: The build is completely silent: no audio path is ever created
issues.detail: With AudioContext, webkitAudioContext, OfflineAudioContext and Audio proxied before page load, the constructor count stayed at 0 across page load, a warm-up pointer press, keyboard notes, MIDI note-on and sustain toggling. There are no <audio>/<video> elements and grep over the served build/assets/index-peaxqnv0.js finds no Web Audio symbol whatsoever. PianoEngine.render() - the only sound-producing routine - is called only from artifact/tests/audio.test.ts. The phase-1 core deliverable, 'one dependable piano voice played from the keybed', produces nothing audible on any input path.

issues.title: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and the UI assert an audible path that does not exist
issues.detail: audio.strategy states 'The browser drains the engine into the speakers via the Web Audio path'; the build never constructs an audio object. The status strip reinforces the claim, showing a green dot and 'Basic piano ready (synthesized voice)' from load onward because App.tsx calls status.setReady unconditionally, even though src/piano/status.ts supports honest error/fallback states. This is an affirmative false claim about the audible signal graph, not an omission, and it breaks the honesty contract and the shared completion gate 'Every claimed audio feature is connected to the audible signal graph'.

issues.title: Keybed geometry collapses: 72 of 73 keys render off-canvas and no key is pointer-reachable
issues.detail: artifact/src/hardware/keys.ts assigns key.x as a white-key index (0..42) with width 1, and Keybed.tsx renders left:`${x*100}%` / width:`${width*100}%`. Measured on the served build at 1440x900: key rects span x 69.6 to 56000.5 inside a keybed of x 69.6-1370.4, each white key 1300.7px wide; 1 of 73 keys falls inside the keybed and it covers the whole bed. The 5x5 elementFromPoint grid finds 0 of 73 keys reachable - every probe point resolves to DIV.keys-black, a full-keybed absolutely positioned overlay at z-index 2 - and real mouse presses at three points across the keybed produce no pressed key. The instrument renders as a blank white slab in place of a keyboard, at both 1440x900 and 390x844.

issues.title: Sealed visual audit claims a keybed its own screenshot refutes
issues.detail: evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md states '73 keys, range E1-E7, 43 white / 30 black, black-key height 61% of white. Keys depress on press (CSS transform + aria-pressed)', and the narrow section claims 'all 73 keys and all six sections rendered'. evidence/stage1-desktop.png and evidence/stage1-narrow.png both show an empty white rectangle with a single 'E1' label, which is exactly what I reproduce from build/. IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md also ticks all five phase-1 hard gates including 'The exact keybed count and range for the assigned variant are modeled and playable'.

issues.title: The nine organ drawbars cannot be moved
issues.detail: DrawbarControl passes pos = n/8 into useDragValue but writes the hook's raw 0..1 output straight back to the store, so each gesture re-divides the value and it saturates around 0.09 of travel. Measured on '16 foot drawbar': a real 300px upward drag left aria-valuenow at 0, aria-valuetext '0' and the handle at bottom 0px (travel fraction 0.000 of a 42.3px track); five PageUp presses, one per animation frame, reached only aria-valuenow 1 against a declared aria-valuemax of 8. The phase-1 gate requires every visible panel control to move or press accessibly, and tests/interaction.test.tsx only asserts the drawbar value is an integer in 0..8, which a stuck value satisfies.

issues.title: Segmented faders report a value that contradicts what they render
issues.detail: FaderControl computes valueText as `${Math.round(n)}/${segments-1}` on the un-normalised store value. At rest 'Organ level' exposes aria-valuenow 0.7 with aria-valuetext '1/11' while the cap sits at 70% and 8 of 12 ladder segments are lit; 'Piano layer A level' reads '1/11' at 0.8 with 9 lit. A screen-reader user and a sighted user get different readings of the same control.

issues.title: Keys are focusable buttons with no keyboard handler; Home/End are deltas
issues.detail: Each of the 73 key elements has role=button and tabIndex=0 but no onKeyDown, so a focused key does nothing on Enter or Space (Space is captured globally for sustain) - 73 dead tab stops between index 120 and 193. Separately, useDragValue maps Home to a +1 delta and End to a +0 delta rather than jumping to max/min: on 'Filter cutoff' End was a no-op (0.8 -> 0.8) while Home clamped to 1.0.

issues.title: Rotary Speaker block is missing from the performance band
issues.detail: The visual spec's performance sectionLandmarks require rotary speaker controls on the exposed red chassis of that band, citing the variant photograph at roughly x 2200-2500 of 11600. The rendered performance section holds only Pitch stick, Modulation wheel, Master level and branding; the rotary controls appear in Organ (organ.rotary-speed, organ.rotary-drive) and again in Effects (fx.rotary-speed, fx.rotary-on).

issues.title: Instrument aspect ratio is far from the variant photograph
issues.detail: Measured instrument box at 1440x900 is 1302.7 x 600, an aspect ratio of 2.171 against the 3.0951 the variant specifies. The candidate declares this deliberately in evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md as a trade to keep the control inventory unclipped, so it is honest, but it is a large deviation and the extra vertical space is what the blank keybed occupies.
